nonblocking_issues.title: Single-seed development and pretrained-seen scope
nonblocking_issues.details: Scientific evidence supports the reported bounded development result only. The face primary score is 4496, below flat4506; the target4754 is unmet. Existing report already discloses the central scope limits.

nonblocking_issues.title: Architecture and capacity change together
nonblocking_issues.details: Source arithmetic independently gives face64737 parameters/25 tensors and flat456102/10. This is not an isolated face-conditioning or attention ablation.

nonblocking_issues.title: Saved scalar verification is not raw replay
nonblocking_issues.details: Mask arrays, full candidate boxes and selection logits are absent. Their scalar aggregates/rank consistency were checked; no raw Mask/full-candidate/model/optimizer replay was performed. Entropy is uncalibrated.

nonblocking_issues.title: Observed cross-process differences
nonblocking_issues.details: Initial saved Mask IoU differs at rows2058,18482; face initial/terminal also differs at16804. Formal selected query differs on3 bbs and2 bbf rows; coarse boxes differ on9503/9502. Cause is not isolated, and learning cannot be inferred from Mask scalar drift.

nonblocking_issues.title: Measured target clipping and floor exposure
nonblocking_issues.details: 386 of178668 matched face targets lie outside distribution support and are clamped after finite checks, across222 updates. Formal selected size floor exposure is43 axes/41 rows bbs and40/40 bbf. All saved values remain finite and recount threshold differences are zero.

nonblocking_issues.title: Inactive inherited helpers
nonblocking_issues.details: Some inherited diagnostic/metric helpers are unused; no current result depends on them. This triggers the checklist dead-code WARN without a blocking defect or task-related need for refactoring.

nonblocking_issues.title: Historical closure and bounded dependency evidence
nonblocking_issues.details: Controller/collector source and receipts support completion, metric-best retention, exact owned-face deletion and zero weights downloaded/archive. No new remote readback, raw weights, or complete V99 chain manifest were supplied; the entire live dependency chain is not independently certified.

nonblocking_issues.title: Common order and original-G baseline evidence boundaries
nonblocking_issues.details: Face exact-once/order is freshly recounted. Flat training NDJSON is absent, so common ordering relies on runner assertions and receipt. Standalone original-G formal rows are absent: +1 supports recorded same-run coarse-to-face comparison, not a newly replayed G benchmark.

gt_provenance.details: Dataset annotations identify scene/object; scan object geometry provides target boxes and point-index masks. Predicted Mask support remains a feature. Native two-stage/object-input and token-map/auxiliary conventions remain; no additional GT inference gate is introduced. Raw dataset and detector payloads were not supplied, so provenance is source-traced with saved witnesses.

score_normalization.details: Raw selected IoU strict >.25/.50 counts use actual row denominators. Mask IoU uses dataset-mask intersection/union, and mean is saved sum/n*100. Prediction softmax/support normalization does not normalize reported performance. Selected final/coarse boxes were freshly recomputed; Mask/oracles only saved-scalar recounted.

result_existence.details: All 70 primary files exist; all numbers in the supplied terminal summary reproduce. Full formal row identities, ordering, both modes, native counters, receipt hashes and exit/closure/retention records agree. No metric stitching found. Weight restore and retirement are source/receipt supported, not freshly executed or remotely read back by this audit.

dead_code.details: All claimed Box/Mask and diagnostic paths are actually called. Inherited NumPy softmax, DIoU and preflight route helpers are not called by this pipeline and support no claimed result. Native last/bbs is primary; bbf remains separate. Same selected query supplies Box and Mask. No code cleanup is required for the bounded report.

scope.details: One seed2027 run per architecture. 6887 module holdout rows/106 physical scenes are upstream-pretrained-seen; 9508 formal rows/141 physical scenes are development validation. Architecture and capacity change together. Cross-process outputs are observably nonidentical. No generalization, isolated direction-conditioning, calibrated entropy or extra dataset/teacher/quality-loss result follows.

evaluation_type.details: Face and flat initial/terminal/formal Box and Mask performance use dataset ground truth. GT oracle diagnostics are not deployed selection. Native training consistency losses do not change benchmark classification. This audit is saved-record verification, not a new model evaluation.
